fusions.name: Flung Fold
fusions.desc: Throws a fold of your mantle that wraps the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage and leaving it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Warp and Weft
fusions.desc: Weaves your arms over and under each other across a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Draped in Borrowed Colour
fusions.desc: Veils you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Wrapped as You Go
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
